messages.author: a190ba1562a8dae9
messages.subject: Error: attempt to apply non-function
parts:
Hi,

below an example of a qplot failure when seq is the name of a variable
in the calling environment. I would consider this a nuisance, maybe
even a bug. Maybe it is related to the use of parent.frame() in
qqplot?

Cheers,
Jochen

library(ggplot2)
x <- -10:10
y <- sin(x)
s <- data.frame(x=x, y=y)
qplot(x=x, y=y, data=s)
# works

seq <- s
qplot(x=x, y=y, data=s)
# Error in get(x, envir = this, inherits = inh)(this, ...) :
# attempt to apply non-function

rm(seq)
qplot(x=x, y=y, data=s)
# works again
